Herdr fork preview: HERDR_BIN_PATH survives live updates

Source: befd45c9464d82a96e145280d4e1eada1189f28e (PR #498).

HERDR_BIN_PATH stays valid after a live update, so agents and scripts in panes keep finding herdr after the next update (#498).

After a live update the server runs from its update directory, and the next update removes that directory. Panes, agents, plugin actions, plugin panes and custom commands now get the installed herdr path in HERDR_BIN_PATH instead, so later `"$HERDR_BIN_PATH" …` calls keep working (#498).

Includes the previous previews' changes: the Topics switch waits for the agent to go idle, seed_too_large and start_failed for topic suggestions, owner grants for browser keys, topic suggestions with accept, dismiss and Organise, a per-agent Topics switch, a same-computer app link from `herdr pair`, close an agent's question from the chat, account-bound guest shares, a retried short-invite upload, agents that wait for a late-mounted saved directory at restore, an agent restarted in its own pane keeps its name, topics for omp agents, api-bridge that follows a peer's live update, omp form tables and formatting in Herdrup, guests answer omp forms in the chat, transcript pages list re-sent entries, the update card clears itself after a restart on fork builds, `herdr fence explain`, live updates under systemd, image thumbnails in Gram, guest chat history that replays correctly when scrolling up, the pane fence and per-agent pane fence (off by default), shared chats no longer fill with old messages, faster and more reliable on slow connections, omp forms answerable from the phone, Gram knows which machines it can reach, chat with a brand-new omp agent, more reliable form answers, omp forms with a text box and other omp question forms answerable from Herdrup, a safer server stop, guest access that follows a recreated agent, agents in very small panes come back after a restart, safe agent renames, the latest upstream fixes, agent restart keeps the agent's name, turn origin and finish notifications for your own requests, renaming or clearing a name an agent left behind, Windows api-bridge and pairing fixes, HTML and SVG types in Gram, many guest requests on one encrypted connection, the herdrup.app relay addresses, short invite links, guest answers, faster file-transfer request handling, and named sessions no longer replace the default session's guest relay connection.

Update through Herdrup's Update herdr card or `herdr update` on the preview channel. The release manifest is signed through the owner's keyring. All five assets are built from the pinned source commit.
